hero_eyebrow: A historic space with a modern spirit
hero_lede: Food and drink are in the package, not bolted onto it. There is a commercial kitchen in the building and a full bar in the Lobby, so nothing arrives cold and nobody queues in a hallway. It is what makes this an all-inclusive wedding venue with a bar, rather than a room you have to stock yourself.
objection_1_a: It is cooked in the building, not trucked in. Den 1880 works with catering partners including Gourmet Chef at Your Table — a past client named them unprompted in their review of the night.
objection_2_a: A staffed bar in the Lobby, included in the package rather than billed separately. Bar enhancements are an add-on if you want something particular poured.
objection_3_a: Menus are built with your chef rather than picked off a card, so restrictions get designed in during planning instead of improvised on the night.
food_intro: Four things that are in the package rather than four vendors to chase.
food_1_body: Chef-led menus built with you rather than picked off a card. Den 1880 works with catering partners including Gourmet Chef at Your Table, named by a past client in their review of the night.

food_4_body: Menus are built with your chef, so restrictions get handled in the planning rather than improvised on the night.

why_1_body: An 1880 heritage building with original wood, ornate chandeliers, marble and coloured lighting. Couples arrive with flowers and a cake.
why_2_body: Venue, open bar, catering, AV, furniture, staff and parking quoted together. One team, one invoice, one point of contact.
